questions.q: For $y_1=e^x$, $y_2=e^{2x}$ (solutions of $y''-3y'+2y=0$), compute the Wronskian $W = y_1y_2' - y_1'y_2$.

questions.answer: $y_1'=-\sin x$, $y_2'=\cos x$. $W = \cos x\cos x - (-\sin x)\sin x = \cos^2x+\sin^2x = 1$.

questions.q: State the variation of parameters formula for a particular solution of $y'' + p(x)y' + q(x)y = g(x)$, given independent solutions $y_1,y_2$ of the homogeneous equation with Wronskian $W$.

sections.heading: A forcing term with no undetermined-coefficients trial form

questions.q: Solve $y'' + y = \tan x$ for $-\frac{\pi}{2}<x<\frac{\pi}{2}$ using variation of parameters.
questions.answer: Here $y_1=\cos x$, $y_2=\sin x$, $W=1$, $g=\tan x$. Since $\int\cos x\tan x\,dx=\int\sin x\,dx=-\cos x$ and $\int\sin x\tan x\,dx=\int\sec x\,dx-\int\cos x\,dx=\ln|\sec x+\tan x|-\sin x$, we get $y_p=-\cos x\left[\ln|\sec x+\tan x|-\sin x\right]+\sin x(-\cos x)=-\cos x\ln|\sec x+\tan x|$. General solution: $y = C_1\cos x + C_2\sin x - \cos x\ln|\sec x+\tan x|$.

sections.heading: A repeated root, with forcing dividing by x

questions.q: Solve $y'' - 2y' + y = \dfrac{e^x}{x}$ ($x>0$) using variation of parameters.
questions.answer: $r^2-2r+1=(r-1)^2=0$, so $y_1=e^x$, $y_2=xe^x$, and $W=e^{2x}$. With $g=e^x/x$: $\dfrac{y_2g}{W}=1$ so $\int = x$; $\dfrac{y_1g}{W}=\dfrac{1}{x}$ so $\int=\ln x$. Then $y_p = -e^x(x) + xe^x(\ln x) = xe^x(\ln x - 1)$. Absorbing the $-xe^x$ term into the arbitrary constant on $y_2$, the general solution is $y = C_1e^x + C_2xe^x + xe^x\ln x$.

questions.q: Solve $y'' - y = e^{2x}$ by variation of parameters, then check the particular solution using undetermined coefficients.
questions.answer: $y_1=e^x$, $y_2=e^{-x}$, $W=-2$. With $g=e^{2x}$: $\dfrac{y_2g}{W}=-\frac{1}{2}e^x$, integral $-\frac{1}{2}e^x$; $\dfrac{y_1g}{W}=-\frac{1}{2}e^{3x}$, integral $-\frac{1}{6}e^{3x}$. So $y_p=-e^x(-\frac{1}{2}e^x)+e^{-x}(-\frac{1}{6}e^{3x})=\frac{1}{2}e^{2x}-\frac{1}{6}e^{2x}=\frac{1}{3}e^{2x}$. Check by undetermined coefficients: try $Ae^{2x}$ (no resonance, since $2$ is not a root of $r^2-1=0$): $4A-A=1 \Rightarrow A=\frac{1}{3}$. Matches. General solution: $y = C_1e^x+C_2e^{-x}+\frac{1}{3}e^{2x}$.
